title: Ellsworth silo abandoned with access plug open
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: And in 1978, one year after Mario and Michael, a security team at the base abandoned a silo with the access plug open

plain: In 1978, at the nuclear missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a security team is said to have abandoned a missile silo and left its access plug open. Michels tells this himself and places it one year after an earlier incident with two airmen he names only as Mario and Michael. If true, a team leaving a nuclear silo open would point to something frightening enough to make trained guards walk away.
